groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.subtitle: Your week's meals, your usual products, your stores.
groceries.catalog-subtitle: Save the things your household buys. Every recipe can use these preferences, and they show up in Common items for adding in one tap.
groceries.url-hint: Paste an HTTPS link to the exact product you buy. The link is a bookmark; prices and stock are checked at the store.
groceries.ingredient-hint: Choose an existing ingredient, or type a new name to create it.
groceries.ingredient-permission: Choose an existing ingredient, or ask your Mealie administrator for Organize permission to create ingredients.
groceries.package-hint: Optional. A 1 lb pack has amount 1 and unit lb. Use items only when the recipe counts the same item.
groceries.no-products: Start with the products you buy most often.
groceries.no-products-detail: Save a product against its ingredient once. Your next week's list can reuse it automatically.
groceries.add-rule: Add pantry amount or weekly staple
groceries.edit-rule: Edit pantry amount or weekly staple
groceries.recurring-mode: How to include it each week
groceries.minimum: Bring the weekly total up to this amount
groceries.extra: Add this amount to recipe needs
groceries.pantry-hint: Enter what you have before shopping. This week keeps its starting stock after purchases begin; later pantry edits apply to future weeks. Quantities are not automatically consumed.
groceries.staple-hint: Minimum totals avoid duplicating ingredients already needed by recipes. Extra amounts are added for other household use.
groceries.no-rules: No amounts saved yet. Mealie's on-hand ingredients still work.
groceries.stores-this-week: Where are you shopping this week?
groceries.skip-hint: An exact pantry amount takes precedence over the on-hand flag.
groceries.no-dinners: Add dinners to your meal plan, or start with weekly staples and manual items.
groceries.multiplier-hint: 1 means the recipe as written. Use 0 to skip buying for that meal, such as leftovers.
groceries.suggestions-hint: Uses planner rules, ratings, ingredients on hand, and planned-meal history.
groceries.no-suggestions: Import some recipes to get dinner ideas.
groceries.no-list-detail: Choose your stores, then generate the week's list. You can update it as the plan changes.
groceries.nothing-needed: Everything on this view is covered.
groceries.assignment-hint: This choice applies to this week's items. Your saved product preferences stay the same.
groceries.manual-store: Buy at a store without choosing a product
groceries.manual-item-hint: Choose an ingredient to use saved products, or enter any household item.
groceries.delete-rule-confirm: Remove this pantry amount or weekly rule?
groceries.changes-pending: Your store choices or multipliers have changed. Update the list to apply them.

restock.title: All stocked up | One thing to pick up | {count} things to pick up
restock.goes-on-this-week: Things you add go on this week’s list and stay until someone checks them off.
restock.goes-on-week: Things you add go on the list for the week of {week} and stay until someone checks them off.
restock.goes-on-next-list: Things you add wait here and join the next grocery list you make.
restock.waiting-for-list: Waiting for the next grocery list: {items}.
restock.on-week: On the list for the week of {week}
restock.empty: Nothing yet. Add things here as you run out.
restock.amount-hint: Leave empty for the usual amount
restock.note: Note, like a brand or size

common-items.title: Common items
common-items.goes-on-this-week: Tap what you need and it goes on this week’s list.
common-items.goes-on-week: Tap what you need and it goes on the list for the week of {week}.
common-items.goes-on-next-list: Tap what you need. It waits for the next grocery list you make.
common-items.empty-detail: Common items are the ingredients you’ve saved products for. Add the things you buy most often in Preferred products, and they’ll show up here.

assistant.title: Ask the kitchen
assistant.dek: Tell it what you’re out of, or ask about the week’s dinners, the grocery list, or your recipes.
assistant.needs-ai: The assistant needs an AI provider
assistant.needs-ai-manager: Add one in your group settings, such as a ChatGPT subscription, and the assistant is ready to go.
assistant.needs-ai-member: Ask whoever manages your Mealie group to set up an AI provider.
assistant.empty: Try one of these, or ask anything.
assistant.starter-out-of: We’re out of rice and paper towels
assistant.starter-list: What’s still on the grocery list?
assistant.placeholder: Ask, or say what you’re out of…

messages.title: Messages
messages.dek: Notes for everyone in the household about groceries, dinners and the week.
messages.empty-detail: Start with something like “We’re out of milk” or “Tacos on Thursday?”
messages.notifications-on: This device gets a notification for each new message.
messages.notifications-off: Get a notification on this device when someone writes.
messages.notifications-needs-install: To get notifications on an iPhone or iPad, add Mealie to your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open it from there and turn them on here.
messages.notifications-denied: Notifications are blocked for Mealie. Turn them on in the device’s Settings under Notifications, then come back.
messages.notifications-unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications from Mealie.
messages.test-sent: Sent. It should show up in a moment.
messages.test-none: No device is set up for notifications yet.

recipe-explorer.title: The recipe box
recipe-explorer.subtitle: Every recipe in the house. Search by name or ingredient, or narrow it down by category, tag, tool or food.

navigation.tagline: Recipes, the week’s dinners and the shopping, in one place.

this-week.title: This week
this-week.nothing-tonight-detail: Pick something from your recipes, or try one of these.
this-week.dinners-planned: No dinners planned | {count} dinner planned | {count} dinners planned
this-week.groceries-left: Nothing left to buy | {count} thing left to buy | {count} things left to buy
this-week.groceries-done: Everything on this week’s list is in the cart.
this-week.no-list-detail: Build it from this week’s dinners, sorted by store and aisle.

events.event-delete-confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this event?
events.new-notification-form-description: Mealie uses the Apprise library to generate notifications. They offer many options for services to use for notifications. Refer to their wiki for a comprehensive guide on how to create the URL for your service. If available, selecting the type of your notification may include extra features.
events.apprise-url-is-left-intentionally-blank: Since Apprise URLs typically contain sensitive information, this field is left intentionally blank while editing. If you wish to update the URL, please enter the new one here, otherwise leave it blank to keep the current URL.
events.what-events: What events should this notifier subscribe to?
events.when-a-new-user-joins-your-group: When a new user joins your group

general.confirm-delete-generic: Are you sure you want to delete this?
general.name: Name
general.subject: Subject
general.title: Title
general.confirm-delete-generic-with-name: Are you sure you want to delete this {name}?
general.confirm-delete-own-admin-account: Please note that you are trying to delete your own admin account! This action cannot be undone and will permanently delete your account?
general.your-browser-does-not-support-clipboard: Your browser does not support clipboard
general.copied-items-to-clipboard: No item copied to clipboard|One item copied to clipboard|Copied {count} items to clipboard
general.discard-changes-description: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?
general.clipboard-copy-failure: Failed to copy to the clipboard.
general.confirm-delete-generic-items: Are you sure you want to delete the following items?
general.cant-create-permission: Can't create. Please contact your administrator to get permission.

settings.keep-my-recipes-private-description: Sets your group and all recipes defaults to private. You can always change this later.

group.manage-members-description: Manage the permissions of the members in your household. {manage} allows the user to access group management areas, {organize} allows the user to manage group data such as foods, tags, and categories, and {invite} allows the user to generate invitation links for other users. Group owners cannot change their own permissions.
group.private-group-description: Setting your group to private will disable all public view options. This overrides any individual public view settings
group.enable-public-access-description: Make group recipes public by default, and allow visitors to view recipes without logging-in
group.allow-users-outside-of-your-group-to-see: Allow users outside of your group to see your recipes

When enabled you can use a public share link to share specific recipes without authorizing the user. When disabled, you can only share recipes with users who are in your group or with a pre-generated private link
group.show-nutrition-information-description: When enabled the nutrition information will be shown on the recipe if available. If there is no nutrition information available, the nutrition information will not be shown
group.show-recipe-assets-description: When enabled the recipe assets will be shown on the recipe if available
group.default-to-landscape-view-description: When enabled the recipe header section will be shown in landscape view
group.disable-users-from-commenting-on-recipes: Disable users from commenting on recipes
Hides the comment section on the recipe page and disables commenting
group.you-must-select-a-group-before-selecting: You must select a group before selecting a household

ai-provider-settings.ai-providers-description: Connect an AI provider to turn on Ask, recipe imports from links, photos, PDFs and videos, and smarter ingredient parsing. A ChatGPT plan works with nothing extra to pay. You can skip this and add one later in your group settings.
ai-provider-settings.ai-provider-settings-description: Connect an AI provider to turn on Ask, recipe imports from links, photos, PDFs and videos, and smarter ingredient parsing.
ai-provider-settings.default-provider-description: Runs Ask, imports from links, PDFs and videos, and ingredient parsing. AI features are off without one.
ai-provider-settings.audio-provider-description: Transcribes videos that have no captions. It needs an API-key provider; a ChatGPT plan can't transcribe.
ai-provider-settings.image-provider-description: Reads photos and scanned pages, for recipes from pictures and PDF cookbooks.
ai-provider-settings.api-key-description-create: Your provider's API key for authentication. If your service (e.g. Ollama) doesn't use an API key, you still have to put something here.
ai-provider-settings.api-key-description-edit: Leave this blank unless you want to change it.
ai-provider-settings.base-url-description: If you're using OpenAI leave this blank. Must be an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. "http://localhost:11434/v1").
ai-provider-settings.model-description: Which model your AI provider should use (e.g. "gpt-5-mini").
ai-provider-settings.no-default-provider-warning: No default provider is chosen, so AI features are off.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-description: Uses your ChatGPT plan's usage limits instead of paying for API usage. It reads text, photos and video captions, but can't transcribe audio.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-model-description: Leave this blank to use your plan's default model.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-waiting: Waiting for you to approve on OpenAI's page…
ai-provider-settings.provider-type-chatgpt-description: Sign in with your ChatGPT plan. Nothing extra to pay.
ai-provider-settings.provider-type-api-key-description: A key from OpenAI or another OpenAI-compatible service, billed per use.
ai-provider-settings.provider-name-description: A label, so you can tell providers apart.
ai-provider-settings.api-key-intro: Use a key from OpenAI, or from any service with an OpenAI-compatible API, such as a local Ollama server. Requests are billed to that account.
ai-provider-settings.request-timeout-description: How long to wait for a reply before giving up.
ai-provider-settings.test-connection-succeeded-images: It works, and it can read photos too.
ai-provider-settings.test-connection-succeeded-text-only: It works. It can't read images, so it won't be used for photo imports.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-step-allow-detail: ChatGPT turns sign-in codes down until you allow them. In ChatGPT, open Settings → Security and turn on Device code authorization for Codex. You only need to do this once.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-step-code-start: Mealie gets a one-time code from OpenAI. You enter it on OpenAI's site, on this device or any other.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-step-code-detail: Copy this code, then enter it on OpenAI's page.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-step-approve-detail: Sign in to ChatGPT there if it asks, paste the code, and approve. Then come back here: this page notices when you're done.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-signed-in-detail: All set. Tap Add to save it.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-sign-in-failed-detail: OpenAI didn't accept the sign-in. Check that device code authorization is on (step 1), then get a new code.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-code-expired: The code expired before it was used. Get a new code to try again.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-help-went-wrong-detail: Your account doesn't allow sign-in with a code yet. Turn it on in step 1, then come back and get a new code.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-help-workspace: You use ChatGPT through work or school
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-help-workspace-detail: A workspace admin has to allow device code sign-in for Codex. Or sign in with a personal ChatGPT account.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-help-expired-detail: Codes last 15 minutes. Get a new one and enter it right away.
ai-provider-settings.chatgpt-help-stuck-detail: Add an API key provider instead, or skip AI for now and add it later in your group settings.
ai-provider-settings.empty-detail: Connect one to turn on Ask, recipe imports from photos, PDFs and videos, and smarter ingredient parsing.
ai-provider-settings.roles-detail: Adding a provider fills in any job that's still empty. Change them here if you have more than one.
ai-provider-settings.no-audio-providers: Only an API-key provider can transcribe audio

household.private-household-description: Setting your household to private will disable all public view options. This overrides any individual public view settings
household.lock-recipe-edits-from-other-households: Lock recipe edits from other households
household.lock-recipe-edits-from-other-households-: When enabled only users in your household can edit recipes created by your household
household.default-recipe-preferences-description: These are the default settings when a new recipe is created in your household. These can be changed for individual recipes in the recipe settings menu.

meal-plan.numberOfDaysPast-hint: Number of days in the past on page load
meal-plan.numberOfDays-hint: Number of days on page load
meal-plan.no-recipes-match-your-rules: No recipes match your meal plan rules
meal-plan.meal-plan-rules-description: You can create rules for auto selecting recipes for your meal plans. These rules are used by the server to determine the random pool of recipes to select from when creating meal plans. Note that if rules have the same day/type constraints then the rule filters will be merged. In practice, it's unnecessary to create duplicate rules, but it's possible to do so.
meal-plan.new-rule-description: When creating a new rule for a meal plan you can restrict the rule to be applicable for a specific day of the week and/or a specific type of meal. To apply a rule to all days or all meal types you can set the rule to "Any" which will apply it to all the possible values for the day and/or meal type.

chowdown.description-long: Mealie natively supports the chowdown repository format. Download the code repository as a .zip file and upload it below.
chowdown.title: Chowdown

nextcloud.description: Migrate data from a Nextcloud Cookbook instance
nextcloud.description-long: Nextcloud recipes can be imported from a zip file that contains the data stored in Nextcloud. See the example folder structure below to ensure your recipes are able to be imported.
nextcloud.title: Nextcloud Cookbook

copymethat.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from Copy Me That. Export your recipes in HTML format, then upload the .zip below.
copymethat.title: Copy Me That Recipe Manager

paprika.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from the Paprika application. Export your recipes from paprika, rename the export extension to .zip and upload it below.
paprika.title: Paprika Recipe Manager

mealie-pre-v1.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from the Mealie application from a pre v1.0 release. Export your recipes from your old instance, and upload the zip file below. Note that only recipes can be imported from the export. This applies only to instances older than v1.0. A backup taken from v1.0 or later should be restored with the backup and restore tools.
mealie-pre-v1.title: Mealie Pre v1.0

tandoor.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from Tandoor. Export your data in the "Default" format, then upload the .zip below.
tandoor.title: Tandoor Recipes

cookn.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from DVO Cook'n X3. Export a cookbook or menu in the "Cook'n" format, rename the export extension to .zip, then upload the .zip below.
cookn.title: DVO Cook'n X3

migration.recipe-data-migrations-explanation: Recipes can be migrated from another supported application to Mealie. This is a great way to get started with Mealie. Moving data between Mealie instances, or restoring an earlier Mealie backup, is done with the backup and restore tools instead.
migration.migration-description: Coming from another application, or a version of Mealie older than v1.0? Check out migrations and see if your data can be imported.

plantoeat.title: Plan to Eat
plantoeat.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from Plan to Eat. Upload a ZIP archive, CSV, or TXT file exported from Plan to Eat.

myrecipebox.title: My Recipe Box
myrecipebox.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from My Recipe Box. Export your recipes in CSV format, then upload the .csv file below.

recipekeeper.title: Recipe Keeper
recipekeeper.description-long: Mealie can import recipes from Recipe Keeper. Export your recipes in zip format, then upload the .zip file below.

new-recipe.error-details: Only websites containing ld+json or microdata can be imported by Mealie. Most major recipe websites support this data structure. If your site cannot be imported but there is json data in the log, please submit a github issue with the URL and data.
new-recipe.error-title: Looks Like We Couldn't Find Anything
new-recipe.html-or-json-error-details: Mealie could not find a recipe in the data you provided. Only ld+json or microdata containing a schema.org Recipe can be imported. If you're pasting JSON, make sure it declares both "@context": "https://schema.org/" and "@type": "Recipe".
new-recipe.paste-in-your-recipe-data-each-line-will: Paste in your recipe data. Each line will be treated as an item in a list
new-recipe.url-form-hint: Copy and paste a link from your favorite recipe website
new-recipe.copy-and-paste-the-source-url-of-your-da: Copy and paste the source URL of your data (optional)
new-recipe.trim-whitespace-description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace as well as blank lines
new-recipe.trim-prefix-description: Trim first character from each line
new-recipe.split-by-numbered-line-description: Attempts to split a paragraph by matching '1)' or '1.' patterns

page.not-found-detail: It may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

recipe.delete-confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this recipe?
recipe.admin-delete-confirmation: You're about to delete a recipe that isn't yours using admin permissions. Are you sure?
recipe.delete-image-confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this recipe image?
recipe.title: Title
recipe.failed-to-add-recipes-to-list: Failed to add recipe to list
recipe.failed-to-add-recipe-to-mealplan: Failed to add recipe to meal plan
recipe.timeline-no-events-found-try-adjusting-f: No events found. Try adjusting your search filters.
recipe.added-to-timeline-but-failed-to-add-imag: Added to timeline, but failed to add image
recipe.api-extras-description: Recipes extras are a key feature of the Mealie API. They allow you to create custom JSON key/value pairs within a recipe, to reference from 3rd party applications. You can use these keys to provide information, for example to trigger automations or custom messages to relay to your desired device.
recipe.ingredients-not-parsed-description: It looks like your ingredients aren't parsed yet. Click the "{parse}" button below to parse your ingredients into structured foods.
recipe.attach-images-hint: Attach images by dragging & dropping them into the editor
recipe.image-drop-unsupported: This image can't be attached directly. Save it to your device, then drag the file in.
recipe.recipes-with-units-or-foods-defined-cann: Recipes with units or foods defined cannot be parsed.
recipe.select-one-of-the-various-ways-to-create: Select one of the various ways to create a recipe
recipe.import-with-ai-description: Create a recipe from just about anything using AI. Give it a link, upload photos of a recipe, paste a recipe as text, HTML, or JSON, or use any combination of the three. Everything you provide is read together as a single recipe.
recipe.import-with-ai-subtitle: Import from text, photos, or URL
recipe.import-with-ai-video-description: You can import from videos too, like those on YouTube or Instagram. Paste the video's URL and Mealie will read its captions and description, and the written recipe it links to if there is one, along with anything else you provide.
recipe.import-with-ai-without-ai-question: Want to create a recipe without using AI?
recipe.import-with-ai-url-hint: Optional. Saved as the recipe's source. Videos are read from their captions; other pages are read for their content.
recipe.import-with-ai-content: Recipe text, HTML, JSON, or notes
recipe.import-with-ai-content-hint: Optional. Paste a recipe, or the contents of a page Mealie can't reach. Combined with anything else you provide, so you can also use it for notes, like what to name the recipe or a detail to correct.
recipe.import-with-ai-provider-required: To import recipes with AI, configure a default provider in your group's AI settings.
recipe.import-with-ai-image-provider-required: To create recipes from photos, configure an image provider in your group's AI settings.
recipe.import-with-ai-error-details: AI was unable to create a recipe from what you provided. Check that it contains a recipe, and try again.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-description: Upload a cookbook PDF, and AI finds every recipe in it and imports them in the background, along with their photos and nutrition. Each recipe is tagged with the cookbook's name.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-resume-description: A whole cookbook takes a lot of AI requests. If an import stops partway, for example because a ChatGPT plan's usage limit was reached, import the same PDF again: recipes that were already imported from it are skipped.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-name-hint: Tags the recipes, and names the cookbook under Cookbooks
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-add-organizers: Add tags, categories, and tools to each recipe
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-add-organizers-hint: Uses one more AI request per recipe, and creates any tags, categories, and tools you don't have yet.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-text-only: There's no image provider in your group's AI settings, so only the PDF's text will be read. Text from cookbooks laid out in columns can come out jumbled, so set up an image provider for the best results.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-in-progress: Importing {name}. This runs in the background, so you can leave this page.
recipe.import-cookbook-pdf-partial: Finished importing {name}, but not everything could be imported. Import the PDF again to retry.
recipe.create-new-organizers-hint: Tags, categories, and tools found on the recipe are always matched against the ones you already have. Turn this on to also create the ones you don't.
recipe.create-recipe-description: Create a new recipe from scratch.
recipe.crop-and-rotate-the-image: Crop and rotate the image so that only the text is visible, and it's in the correct orientation.
recipe.should-translate-description: Translate the recipe into my language
recipe.create-a-recipe-by-providing-the-name-al: Create a recipe by providing the name. All recipes must have unique names.
recipe.new-recipe-names-must-be-unique: New recipe names must be unique
recipe.scrape-recipe-description: Scrape a recipe by url. Provide the url for the site you want to scrape, and Mealie will attempt to scrape the recipe from that site and add it to your collection.
recipe.scrape-recipe-description-transcription: You can also give it a link to a video, like one on YouTube, and Mealie will create the recipe from the video's captions and description.
recipe.scrape-recipe-have-a-lot-of-recipes: Have a lot of recipes you want to scrape at once?
recipe.scrape-recipe-have-ai-read-the-page: Want AI to read the page instead?
recipe.import-from-html-or-json-have-ai-read-it: Want AI to read your data instead?
recipe.scrape-recipe-have-raw-html-or-json-data: Have raw HTML or JSON data?
recipe.scrape-recipe-you-can-import-from-raw-da: You can import from raw data directly
recipe.scrape-recipe-try-importing-raw-html-ins: Try importing the raw HTML instead.
recipe.import-from-zip-description: Import a single recipe that was exported from another Mealie instance.
recipe.import-from-html-or-json-description: Import a single recipe from raw HTML or JSON. This is useful if you have a recipe from a site that Mealie can't scrape normally, or from some other external source.
recipe.json-import-format-description-colon: To import via JSON, it must be in valid format:
recipe.zip-files-must-have-been-exported-from-m: .zip files must have been exported from Mealie
recipe.recipe-bulk-importer-description: The Bulk recipe importer allows you to import multiple recipes at once by queueing the sites on the backend and running the task in the background. This can be useful when initially migrating to Mealie, or when you want to import a large number of recipes.
recipe.recipe-debugger-description: Grab the URL of the recipe you want to debug and paste it here. The URL will be scraped by the recipe scraper and the results will be displayed. If you don't see any data returned, the site you are trying to scrape is not supported by Mealie or its scraper library.
recipe.recipe-debugger-use-openai-description: Use OpenAI to parse the results instead of relying on the scraper library. When creating a recipe via URL, this is done automatically if the scraper library fails, but you may test it manually here.

parser.natural-language-processor-english-only: The Natural Language Processor is trained on English recipes. For recipes in other languages it usually recognizes the amount but not the unit, so the Brute Parser or the OpenAI Parser tends to give better results.
parser.this-unit-could-not-be-parsed-automatica: This unit could not be parsed automatically
parser.this-food-could-not-be-parsed-automatica: This food could not be parsed automatically
parser.ingredient-parser-description: You may need to confirm results we're not sure about or create new foods or units that are required by this recipe. We'll let you know what's needed.
parser.ingredient-parser-final-review-descripti: Once everything looks good, you can review the final results, then apply the changes to this recipe.
parser.ingredient-parser-result-success: No ingredients auto parsed | {count} ingredient auto parsed | {count} ingredients auto parsed
parser.ingredient-parser-result-failed: No ingredients to review | {count} ingredient to review | {count} ingredients to review

recipe-finder.recipe-finder-description: Search for recipes based on ingredients you have on hand. You can also filter by tools you have available, and set a maximum number of missing ingredients or tools.
recipe-finder.no-recipes-found-description: Try adding more ingredients to your search or adjusting your filters

backup.restore-fail: Restore failed. Check your server logs for more details
backup.error-creating-backup-see-log-file: Error Creating Backup. See Log File
backup.experimental-description: Backups are total snapshots of the database and data directory of the site. This includes all data and cannot be set to exclude subsets of data. You can think of this as a snapshot of Mealie at a specific time. These serve as a database agnostic way to export and import data, or back up the site to an external location.
backup.back-restore-description: Restoring this backup will overwrite all the current data in your database and in the data directory and replace them with the contents of this backup. {cannot-be-undone} If the restoration is successful, you will be logged out.
backup.cannot-be-undone: This action cannot be undone - use with caution.
backup.postgresql-note: If you are using PostgreSQL, please review the {backup-restore-process} prior to restoring.
backup.irreversible-acknowledgment: I understand that this action is irreversible, destructive and may cause data loss

token.copy-this-token-for-use-with-an-external: Copy this token for use with an external application. This token will not be viewable again.
token.you-have-token-count: You have no active tokens.|You have one active token.|You have {count} active tokens.

webhooks.description: The webhooks defined below will be executed when a meal is defined for the day. At the scheduled time the webhooks will be sent with the data from the recipe that is scheduled for the day. Note that webhook execution is not exact. The webhooks are executed on a 5 minutes interval so the webhooks will be executed within 5 +/- minutes of the scheduled.

admin.ingredients-natural-language-processor-e: Mealie uses Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) for parsing and processing ingredients. The model used for ingredients is based off a data set of over 100,000 ingredients from a dataset compiled by the New York Times. Note that as the model is trained in English only, you may have varied results when using the model in other languages. This page is a playground for testing the model.

It's not perfect, but it yields great results in general and is a good starting point for manually parsing ingredients into individual fields. Alternatively, you can also use the "Brute" processor that uses a pattern matching technique to identify ingredients.
